scenario: Background: Hunter is an employee at a company whose SOC team received an alert about illegal port scanning activity originating from his workstation (computer name 4ORENSICS, Windows 8.1, IP 10.0.2.15). Hunter denies any involvement and claims the activity was caused by malware. The investigation on 2016-06-21 reveals that Hunter installed multiple offensive security tools (Nmap 7.12, Zenmap, Wireshark, Burp Suite, Tor Browser, OllyDbg, SysinternalsSuite), performed a port scan against scanme.nmap.org, communicated via Skype with contact 'linux-rul3z', used TeamViewer for remote access, and exfiltrated data via Dropbox (Pictures.7z). Anti-forensic tools (Jetico BCWipe, CCleaner, Crypto Swap) were used to destroy evidence. The user's Gmail account is ehptmsgs@gmail.com.
